rows.note: This is the all-purpose logistics term for a consignment of goods being sent or in transit.

example.english: This consignment has already been sent and should arrive tomorrow.
example.traditional: 呢批貨件已經寄出，聽日應該送到。
example.jyutping: ni1 pai1 fo3 gin2 ji5 ging1 gei3 ceot1 ting1 jat6 jing1 goi1 sung3 dou3

rows.note: Use this for the arrangement where a shop sells someone else’s goods and keeps a percentage of the sale.

example.english: This shop uses a consignment arrangement to sell second-hand clothes and takes a commission only after they sell.
example.traditional: 呢間舖頭用寄賣制幫人賣二手衫，賣出先分佣。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 jung6 gei3 maai6 zai3 bong1 jan4 maai6 ji6 sau2 saam1 maai6 ceot1 sin1 fan1 jung2
